CartItemAttribute.name: CartItemAttribute
CartItemAttribute.description: Represents the attributes associated with a cart item, stored as key-value pairs.

AttributeDefinitionId.description: The ID of the attribute definition associated with the cart item attribute.

AttributeName.description: The name of the cart item attribute.

AttributePicklistValueId.description: The ID of the picklist value associated with the cart item attribute.

AttributeValue.description: The value of the cart item attribute, such as Blue or Large.

CartItemId.description: The ID of the cart item to which this attribute is assigned.

ExternalId.description: An auto-generated ID for the attribute record that's stored in an external system, such as the HBase database.

IsPriceImpacting.description: Indicates whether the attribute affects cart pricing (true) or not (false). This field determines whether the Commerce Pricing API calls must be triggered to update the price.

UnitOfMeasure.description: The ID of the unit of measure associated with the cart item attribute.

CartItemAttribute.accessRules: The CartItemAttribute object is available:only if the B2B Commerce license, the Salesforce CPQ feature, and Commerce Dynamic Bundles are enabled in your Salesforce org.
